notes:
- Weapon camos look much better: they now cover the whole gun (receiver, slide, grip, stock,
  handguard, scope body, mag) instead of one part, keep each part's light and dark shading underneath,
  and the patterns were tuned: bigger digital blocks, a proper carbon weave, softer Glacier and Bloodshot
  shading, and Royal Gold / Diamond read as polished metal.
- Top-tier camos got special effects: Royal Gold has a bright sheen sweeping along the gun and a warm
  metallic edge glow; Diamond twinkles and shimmers with rainbow colours as you move; Plasma has crawling
  electric arcs and a pulsing glow; Dark Matter is a window into space (stars with depth, swirling
  nebula, violet edge glow).
- Headshots on the top of the head always count: zombies have a head hitbox that follows the head
  (it used to poke out of the body hitbox when they lean or stagger).
- No more getting hit through walls: zombies need a clear line to you to start and land a hit.
- No more escaping through roofs: rooms have solid ceilings, and if you ever end up outside the
  map or on a roof, you're put back where you last stood within half a second.
